name: Talking to Boop after a failure gets a face on your side
judge: A turn fails, the person vents, then says they'll get it next time. Boop should be on their side both times, and perk up at the encouragement.
reasonable: Put out at the failure. At the venting, sympathetic, annoyed, determined or sad. At the encouragement, hopeful, determined, warm or pleased, or calmer.
unreasonable: Cheerful at their venting, mocking them, ignoring what they say, or getting angrier or sadder at the kind words.

steps.words: don't worry, we'll get it next time
